definitions.explanation: Describes a person or animal that follows instructions or authority without resistance. Can be used positively (well-behaved) or negatively (too submissive).

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧{従順|じゅうじゅん}だ。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{従順|じゅうじゅん}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せた→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: He showed a submissive attitude toward his boss.

examples.japanese: {従順|じゅうじゅん}な⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: If you are only obedient, you cannot express your own opinions.

notes:
{従順|じゅうじゅん} is a な-adjective meaning obedient, docile, or submissive. It can carry either a positive nuance (well-behaved, loyal) or a negative one (too passive, lacking independence).

WRITING:
{従|じゅう} (follow, obey) + ⟦{順|じゅん}→順：03342_jun⟧ (order, compliance). Both characters reinforce the meaning of following without resistance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {従順|じゅうじゅん}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧: a docile personality
- {従順|じゅうじゅん}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: a submissive attitude
- {従順|じゅうじゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧: to follow obediently
- {従順|じゅうじゅん}な⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧: an obedient dog

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{素直|すなお}→素直：00391_sunao⟧: honest, obedient (more positive; implies openness)
- ⟦{大人|おとな}しい→大人しい：02339_otonashii⟧: quiet, docile (gentler nuance)
- {従順|じゅうじゅん} emphasizes compliance with authority more than the others
